11366 vártman n. 'track of a wheel, path' RV. [J. Bloch StudII 19 *vartmā nom. sg. m. after ádhvā m. (cf. pánthā-) became f. in MIA. — √vr̥t¹]
    Pa. vaṭuma- n. 'path, road', Pk. vaṭṭa- n.m., vaṭṭā- f., vaṭṭamaya-, vaḍū̆maga- n., K. wath, dat. °ti f., pog. wat, S. vāṭa f., P. vāṭ, bāṭ f., ḍog. batta f., kgr. bat f., bhaṭ. batt, WPah.bhad. bhal. paṅ. cam. batt f., pāḍ. cur. bat; Ku. bāṭ 'path, pass', bāṭo m. 'path', N. bāṭo (obl. bāṭa postp. 'from'), A. B. bāṭ; Or. bāṭa 'path, place'; Mth. bāṭ 'path', Bhoj. bāt, OAw. OMarw. bāṭa f., H. bāṭ f., G. M. Ko. vāṭ f.; Si. vaṭuma 'road' (← Pa.?), devaṭa 'lane' (de- < dēśá- ?); — Sh. bāṭṷ m. 'wheel'; G. vāṭɔ m. 'tire' (semant. cf. vartaní- f. 'felly of wheel, path' RV., Pa. vattanī- f. 'track, path', Pk. vaṭṭaṇī- f. 'road'). — Deriv.: N. baṭuwā 'traveller'; B. beṭo 'of the road' < *bāṭuā ODBL 491; Or. bāṭuā 'traveller', G. vāṭvɔ m. — X mārga- q.v. — Si. vat 'road' (LM 404, EGS 155) extracted from māvat < *mahāpanthā-. — See vartís- from which some of above NIA. feminine words may phonet. equally well derive.
    *vartmapathika-, *vartmapānīya-, vartmapāla-; *avartmaka- Add., udvartman-, kuvartman-, *gāḍḍavartman-, *gōcaravartman-, *caturvartman-, trivartman-, *duvartmaka-, dvāravartman-, *pādavartman-, *siddhavartman-, suvartman-.
    Addenda: vártman-: WPah.kṭg. bāt, kc. bāṭ f. (obl. -a), J. bā'ṭ f.; Garh. bāṭu 'way'.

2528.html:
2528 ēvam ēva 'just so' AitBr. [ēvá¹]
    Pa. ēvamēva, Aś. shah. man. kāl. evameva, kāl. hevameva, dh. jau. hemeva, NiDoc. emeva, emu, ema; Pk. ēvamēva, ēmēva, ēmēa, ēmia, Ap. emva, emvaï, ēma, ēuṁji 'just so', emvahiṁ, evvahi 'now', P. aivẽ, ivẽ, aiũ, aĩ 'in this way', OAw. imi, lakh. ewaĩ, H. im, OG. ima, G. εm (i emphasized as ε); Si. (inscr.) meva, mevu, mē, later -ma 'enclitic particle of emphasis' (EGS 125 < ēvá¹).
    Addenda: ēvam ēva: Md. -me emphatic enclitic.
    Ap. emvahĩ, evvahĩ, evahĩ: WPah.kṭg. εbbε 'now', kc. ebe; kṭg. ébbhi 'immediately', kc. ebi; OA. ewe 'now', ebho (< ēvam ēva khalu?) AFD 325, OMarw. hiva Vīsaḷa p. 159, OG. hiva(i), hivaḍā̃; — poss. X adhunā́: OG. hivaṇā̃.
    X pron. a-: Pk.amg. havvaṁ 'now', WPah.kc. abe, OA. āwe, H. ab, abhī, OG. hava(i), havaḍā̃.
    X ká-²: WPah.kṭg. kεbε 'when?', kc. kebia, kabhia, kabia 'sometimes, ever'; B. kabe, H. kab 'when?', kabhī 'ever'.
    X tá-: WPah.kṭg. tεbbε 'then', kc. tabe, kṭg. tébbhi 'immediately', kc. tebi, OA. tāwe, tebe, tewe, B. tabe, H. tab, tabhī.
    X yá-: WPah.kṭg. j̈εbbε 'when', kc. j̈abe, kṭg. j̈ebbhi, kc. j̈ebi, OA. jebe, jewe, jāwe, H. jab, jabhī.
